biotools.summary: This resource provides access to genomic data and typing definitions for isolates of the Klebsiella pneumoniae species complex based on various typing methods like MLST, cgMLST, and core genome MLST. It allows data retrieval and analysis for researchers studying antimicrobial resistance and transmission mechanisms.
